In this new illustration she wears a fully covering black long-sleeve high-neck athletic shirt and full-length black training trousers, black sports shoes with small gold details. She sits upright on the edge of a plain flat weight bench, feet firmly on the floor, left free hand resting on left thigh. Her right upper arm is supported against the inside of her right thigh, and she holds one clearly visible dumbbell with a supinated hand, elbow partially flexed. The dumbbell does not touch the leg. Show the entire person, both shoes, all of the bench including legs, and the whole dumbbell, centered with generous black margins on all edges. Opaque black studio background, fixed three-quarter camera, natural proportions and anatomically coherent visible hand grip. Straightforward sports equipment demonstration thumbnail, no captions, no numerical claims, no additional people, no arrows, no collages, no movement sequence. Portrait 2:3.
entries.notes: Imagem de identificação de rosca concentrada com halter, braço apoiado na face interna da coxa, corpo/banco/halter completos. Vestuário alternativo preto com mangas compridas e calça, após bloqueio automático da tentativa original. Limite: margem lateral do banco abaixo de 8%; sem cortes. Sem certificação profissional.

entries.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one professional sports equipment catalogue image for SINGLE-ARM DUMBBELL ROW, a static identification pose. The reference supplies only the same adult athlete's face, dark ponytail and fully covering black-and-gold outfit: long-sleeve high-neck black training shirt, full-length black sports trousers and black/gold shoes. Change the exercise and setting to a one-arm dumbbell row supported by a flat bench: left palm and left knee rest on the padded bench, right foot rests on the floor, back naturally level, neck aligned with spine; right hand grips ONE dumbbell in a neutral grip, right elbow bent and tracking beside torso. Make the support geometry clearly readable from a side three-quarter camera without hiding the grounded foot, supporting hand or knee. Show the entire athlete, full dumbbell and all legs/corners of the bench with generous empty black clearance around the silhouette. Landscape 3:2 composition on opaque plain black background. Coherent anatomy, equipment proportions and visible hand grip. No additional people, extra limbs, arrows, motion trails, captions or numbers.
entries.notes: Remada unilateral identificável, uma mão e um joelho apoiados no banco, pé oposto no chão e halter íntegro. Vestuário alternativo preto com mangas compridas e calça, após bloqueio automático da tentativa original. Margem superior abaixo da meta de 8%, sem cortes. Sem certificação da execução dinâmica.
